status_note: Approved and shipping, ruled by Roc 2026-08-05. Brings the slice to 16 spells.
learn_source: Watch the baker settle the flour sacks at the counter in the Town scene — a feast recipe scaled to the whole town, every batch owed the same as the last, and no scale in town built for feast quantities
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on something with heft once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the hang reads true to a pinch; at baseline it reads only to the nearest stone's-worth. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Rises a hand's breadth and hangs at a height set by its heft — a heavy sack hangs low, a light one high, and two matched sacks hang level with each other
Barely dips off the counter — hangs high and near-level, a small measure declaring itself small
State-dependent: full, it hangs low off its resting place and the hang reads the batch; scraped empty, it hangs high — only the pot's own weight left to bear
no_effect — built into the floor; nothing here the cast can bear up
No physical effect — nothing living is borne up
receivers.reaction_kind: squawk and wing-beat at the stirred air, struts off affronted
reads the hang-heights down the row of sacks and starts tallying them against the feast count
